status: authored 2026-10-06 by the legendaries sweep; generated by tools/hoopa_cradle.py into build/datapacks/cobblers_hoopa_cradle. NOT RUN in any world: nothing here has been seen to spawn, refuse a ball or grant anything. Its in-game checks are listed under runtime_checks.
decision: the owner, 2026-10-06, after the finale run: 'make it catchable for sure'. Defaults recorded in docs/STATE.md the same day and taken here unchanged: Hoopa appears at the cradle when the release runs, once per player, level 60 (the cap after gym 8), and comes back if it faints or is fled from until that player has caught it. Mega Showdown 1.0.2 ships Hoopa's confined and unbound models (review N59), so the default form, confined, is what spawns.

wired_to.transition: data/quests.json unlock_league_after_rift_resolution, invoked only by data/dialogue.json dlg_main_relic_hall_release release_001 ('Release Hoopa.'). Its FIRST effect grants cobblers:flag/rift_crisis_resolved to the releasing player.
wired_to.how: the keeper reads THAT grant, per player: a player holding cobblers:flag/rift_crisis_resolved and not cobblers:hoopa_cradle/caught, standing within near_radius of the cradle, gets their own Hoopa at the spot. The binder stands 8.5 blocks from the spot, inside near_radius, so the Hoopa appears on the keeper's next pass after the release line is acknowledged (at most period_ticks). This is the residents' keeper's 'appears_after' gate (tools/resident_encounters.py gate_sel) made per player with the arena's owner score (tools/arena_runtime.py ar.id).
wired_to.why_not_an_effect_on_the_transition: tools/finale_audit.py check_release_effects runs release_001 in a model in which every called function must be in a pack it reads and a spawn is a 'world_change' it reports as a fault ('the release changes the world'), and tests/test_finale_confrontation.py pins release_fx as the LAST effect. A function effect that spawns would fail both until their author changes them. Keying on the flag the transition grants reaches the same player at the same moment without touching either, and also covers every player who released before this pack was installed.

spot_source: data/relic_underground.json composition.cradle.dais.why: Codex's restrained Hoopa actor stands at (3357, 13, 3306), over the rift_seep block at the dais centre in the floor y12 (geometry.cradle centre [3357, 3306], floor_y 12). tools/hoopa_cradle.py fails closed if the spot leaves the cradle's centre or floor.
level_why: the RCT cap after gym 8 (docs/mechanics/LEAGUE_LEVEL_CAP.md); the release needs both HQ wins, which come after the gyms on the finale chain (data/hq_tower.json finale_order). Above the thrower's cap the level-cap callback breaks the ball anyway (data/level_cap.json), so a player who somehow releases early is refused by that, not by this.
caught_advancement_why: per player and permanent: one minecraft:impossible criterion, granted only by the caught function. Carried across a re-export with every other advancement (tools/carry_players.py).
objectives_why: hp.id is the player's own number (from #next hp.id), and the same score on a Hoopa is its OWNER, matched by score and never by name (the arena's ar.id). hp.gone holds the game time the player's Hoopa was first missed; hp.had is 1 once the player has had one; hp.t is working scratch.

keeper.near_radius_why: the cradle's radius is 16 (geometry.cradle.radius); 20 takes in all of it and the binder's stand at 8.5 from the spot, and no more than the cradle, so the keeper does nothing for a player in the hall or the passage
keeper.respawn_after_ticks_why: a minute of game time after the player's Hoopa is first found missing (fainted, fled from and despawned, or removed): it is back the next time they stand in the cradle after that. Not on the spot of the faint: a beaten Hoopa reappearing under the player's feet reads as a bug
keeper.leash_why: a Hoopa further than this from the spot is put back on it; the cradle's floor runs 16 out, so it never leaves the room

catch.who: the owner of the Hoopa (hp.own equal to the thrower's hp.id), holding the gate flag and not yet the caught advancement. Every other thrower's ball breaks free (set_shakes 0) and they are told why.
catch.fallback: the owner check needs the Pokemon entity to take a tag from MoLang (q.pokemon.add_tag), which the research note lists among the entity functions (docs/research/notes/arena-per-player-opponents.md: EntityMoLangFunctions add_tag/remove_tag/has_tag/uuid at 1.8.0) but nobody has run. If no Hoopa carries the hit tag when the check runs, an ELIGIBLE thrower is allowed, so a missing function makes the check looser, never Hoopa uncatchable.
catch.caught_when: the pokemon_captured callback sees species cobblemon:hoopa caught by a player within catch_radius of the spot. A Hoopa caught anywhere else (a raid den's: COBBLEVERSE-Loot-DP's cobblemonraiddens hoopa table exists) does not count.

message.appear: Hoopa slips out of the dark ring and stays, watching you.
message.refuse: The ball bounces off a ring of light. This Hoopa is waiting for whoever opened its restraint.
message.caught: Hoopa curls into the ball. It came along, this time.

does_not_cover: a player who releases Hoopa and walks out of the cradle before the next keeper pass: their Hoopa appears the next time they stand within near_radius, not before
two players with Hoopas in the cradle at once: each has their own, matched by score; a third player sees both and can battle either, but only an owner's ball can hold
a Hoopa left in the cradle by a player who then logs out stays there (PersistenceRequired) until they come back; it is not swept
whether the confined model renders: a client fact (docs/STATE.md 'Hoopa exists in Cobblemon 1.8.0 ... whether its model renders ... is NOT answered'; review N59 says Mega Showdown 1.0.2 has it)
runtime_checks: staging: a player at the binder with stage cradle_open and both HQ wins chooses 'Release Hoopa.': within a second a level-60 Hoopa stands at (3357, 13, 3306) tagged cobblers.hoopa with hp.own equal to that player's hp.id
the same player faints it: after 1200 ticks, standing in the cradle, a new one appears; nothing appears for a player who has not released
a second player throws at the first player's Hoopa: the ball breaks free and the message shows; the owner's ball can catch it
after the owner catches it: cobblers:hoopa_cradle/caught is granted, and no Hoopa ever appears for them again
catching a raid-den Hoopa elsewhere grants nothing here
